name: entd-gtm
description: ENTD Draw Button — Google Tag Manager custom template and its runtime bundle.

scripts.build: npm run build:prod && npm run build:staging
scripts.build:prod: cd .. && API_HOST=api.entd.tech WEB_HOST=entd.tech npx webpack build --mode production --output-path gtm/build/prod && cd gtm && cat build/prod/index.js src/entd-gtm.js > build/entd-gtm.js
scripts.build:staging: cd .. && API_HOST=api.aientd.space WEB_HOST=aientd.space npx webpack build --mode production --output-path gtm/build/staging && cd gtm && cat build/staging/index.js src/entd-gtm.js > build/entd-gtm.staging.js
